body:
Subject: Exploring New Opportunities Together

Hi Matt,

I hope this message finds you well! Thank you once again for the opportunity to collaborate on the recent project regarding the 24x7x4 support. I truly appreciated the open communication and teamwork we shared throughout the process.

As we look to build on our partnership, I wanted to share three concrete business ideas that I believe could be mutually beneficial for both Procurri and Zion Tech Group:

1. **Managed AI Support Automation** — We can deploy our AI agents to manage Tier-1 and Tier-2 tickets, significantly reducing response times by over 60%. This would streamline your escalation paths while allowing us to run the service as a co-branded offering, maintaining your client relationships while we handle the AI delivery.

2. **AI Readiness & Cost-Optimization Assessments** — We can package the audit framework we discussed into a repeatable, co-branded offering that you can present to prospects. Our team would manage the technical aspects, while you lead the commercial conversations, allowing for a 50/50 revenue split on net margins.

3. **Hybrid-Cloud Migration + AI Ops Pilot** — A 30-day pilot utilizing your current environment alongside our platform could demonstrate measurable reductions in MTTR and cloud cost savings. Following the pilot, we can transition into a Master Service Agreement with pre-agreed pricing.

I’m keen to move forward efficiently and would love to hear your thoughts on these ideas. We can discuss the details via email or set up a quick 30-minute call to lock in the commercial terms. Here’s my Calendly link for scheduling: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup.

Additionally, I encourage you to explore the free services and tools available on our website, which your team can start utilizing right away: https://ziontechgroup.com.

Which of these directions resonates most with you? I can prepare a one-page term sheet for whichever path you prefer.

Looking forward to your feedback!

Best regards,

Kleber Garcia Alcatrão  
CEO, Zion Tech Group
